[RBND.3.1] **`dsc_sha256`** is the hash [RDSC.3.6] defines, which the
DSC's own header carries. Every other artefact's `dsc_sha256` is that value,
copied from the header of the DSC that was active when the artefact was
produced; a runtime must not hash the DSC some other way to fill it.
Nothing outside the `.dsc` file is hashed: a container's framing is not part
of the DSC byte sequence.
